question.text: Effective 1 October 2024 under Finance (No.2) Act 2024, what are the STT rates on (a) sale of options in securities (on premium) and (b) sale of futures in securities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Finance (No.2) Act 2024 (w.e.f. 1 October 2024) increased STT: sale of options (on premium) from 0.0625% to 0.1%; sale of futures from 0.0125% to 0.02%. Delivery-based purchase/sale of listed equity remains 0.1% + 0.1% (both sides). The Trap: Option A is the pre-1-Oct-2024 rate. Option B is a fabricated symmetric rate. Option D inflates to unlisted-offer-for-sale rate. Cross-Exam Context: VIII (Equity Derivatives) tests STT at transaction level; XIX-C tests the STT leakage in Cat III F&O fund P&L. Manager's Pro-Tip: For Cat III F&O-heavy funds, STT is a direct P&L drag — not a recoverable tax. Budget the STT leakage in the performance-reporting template, and test whether structured derivatives (e.g., TRS) can achieve similar exposure with lower STT cost.
